resources.string: A plugin for Drivelog. It reads odometer, fuel, range, average consumption, temperatures and which doors, windows and roof are open from a BMW with an NBT Evo or EntryNav2 head unit, through the DrivelogBridge plugin installed in the head unit, over the car\'s Wi-Fi.\n\nThere is nothing to set up here: in Drivelog, open the car, choose Edit, and pick Drivelog BMW ID6 as its plugin. It works while Drivelog records a trip.
Drivelog is not installed. This plugin does nothing without it.
